title: Witboost Creation Template
description: Schema for template.yaml files that define the wizard form and execution steps for creating Witboost entities (Systems, Components). The template collects user input via a multi-page wizard, renders skeleton files with Nunjucks, publishes to Git, and registers the entity in the catalog.

name.description: Unique template identifier. Lowercase, alphanumeric, dashes, dots, underscores.

title.description: Display name shown in the template catalog.

description.description: Brief description of what this template creates.

icon.description: URL to the icon displayed in the template catalog.

tags.description: Tags for filtering and categorizing templates.

backstage.io/techdocs-ref.description: TechDocs reference. Typically 'dir:.' for co-located documentation.

generates.description: Entity type this template creates. Format depends on the Practice Shaper configuration. Default Data Mesh values: 'componenttype:default/outputport', 'componenttype:default/workload', 'componenttype:default/storage', 'systemtype:default/dataproduct'. Custom practices may define different types.

owner.description: Owner of this template definition (group or user identifier).

type.description: Component/system type this template creates. Must align with the 'generates' value (e.g., 'outputport' for 'componenttype:default/outputport').

parameters.description: Array of wizard pages. Each element defines one page of the creation form with its own title, required fields, and property definitions.

steps.description: Ordered list of actions executed after the user completes the wizard. Typical sequence: fetch:template → publish → register.

output.description: Values and links shown to the user after template execution completes.

title.description: Title displayed at the top of this wizard page.

description.description: Optional help text shown below the title. Supports markdown.

required.description: Property names that must be filled before the user can proceed to the next page.

properties.description: Form field definitions. Each key is a field name, each value is a JSON Schema definition with optional Witboost UI extensions.

allOf.description: Conditional logic using JSON Schema if/then/else for dynamically showing/hiding fields based on other field values.

description.description: Help text shown below the field.

default.description: Default value pre-filled in the form.

enum.description: Fixed list of allowed values. Renders as a dropdown.

items.description: Schema for array element items when type is 'array'.

properties.description: Nested property definitions when type is 'object'.

id.description: Unique step identifier. Used to reference this step's outputs in later steps via ${{ steps.<id>.output.* }}.

input.description: Action-specific input parameters. Values support Nunjucks expressions: ${{ parameters.fieldName }}, ${{ steps.stepId.output.fieldName }}.
